completeness.why: getDateWithWeekendRule now takes the enable flag and mode, and the app and both template sites pass their raw skipWeekend and mode fields with no outer ternary. getNextDate also calls it, but it builds the flag itself as `skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend`. noSkipWeekend is an option only this site has, but the shared definition does not name it, so this site still settles part of whether the rule applies. Between full and partial, so scored partial.

interface.why: One function with the real variation (an enable flag and the solve mode), no speculative options, and each caller maps its own field name. The noSkipWeekend override is folded into a boolean expression at the caller, not made explicit in the definition.
